key.name: toggle-recording
key.description: Keyboard shortcut used by the GNOME Shell extension to start recording or stop and paste.

key.name: paste-after-stop
key.description: When enabled, stopping a recording from the extension restores the previous window and sends a paste shortcut after the daemon copies the transcript.

key.name: check-updates
key.description: When enabled, the GNOME Shell extension periodically checks whether the installed source checkout is behind its upstream branch and shows a notification when an update is available.
